Name: JerryBB's Big Ribbon Collection
Author: JerryBBS2
Description:
[center][size=5][b]JerryBB's Big Ribbon Collection[/b][/size]
[i]Frill Ribbon  ·  Black Ribbon Darling  ·  Yellow Ribbon[/i][/center]

Three sweet hi-res outfits for Fashion Sense, each crowned with a giant ribbon.

[b]Frill Ribbon[/b]
A soft pink giant lace ribbon, peach wavy long hair, a pearl button blouse, a vertical frill lace skirt, double frill puff sleeves and a waist back ribbon.

[b]Black Ribbon Darling[/b]
A big black ribbon trimmed with white frills, pink long twin tails, a pearl button black top, a fluffy black short skirt, black puff sleeves and a black ribbon garter.

[b]Yellow Ribbon[/b]
A giant yellow frill ribbon with long ribbon tails, peach wavy hair with a side bun and an off-shoulder yellow lace top.
Two versions in the Pants tab: the [b]Dress[/b] (long tiered skirt) and the [b]Mini Dress[/b] (short tiered skirt). Wear one of them.

Every outfit is drawn for all four directions.

[size=3][b]IMPORTANT: install JerryBB's FS Outfit Framework[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55346]JerryBB's FS Outfit Framework[/url] is required. The outfits will not load without it.
It keeps hi-res outfits attached to the body while riding a horse, tractor or broom, or sitting on a chair, and keeps the hair on the map and minimap head icon.

[b]Requirements[/b]
- SMAPI 4.0.0 or newer
- Fashion Sense 7.0.0 or newer
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55346]JerryBB's FS Outfit Framework[/url] (REQUIRED)
- The outfits are drawn for GH's Peach Tall Body type (female). Other body mods may not line up.

[b]Installation[/b]
1. Download one edition: English or Korean.
2. Download JerryBB's FS Outfit Framework.
3. Unzip both into your Mods folder.

[b]How to wear[/b]
Open the Hand Mirror. Hair, Hat, Shirt and Pants are in their own tabs.
Sleeves, arm covers, back ribbons, the garter and the long ribbon tails are in the Accessory tab.
Wear the arm cover together with its top, so the arms do not show over the shoulder frill.
Every item name starts with "JerryBB's".

[b]Files[/b]
- All three outfits in one file.
- English and Korean editions. Install only one edition.

[b]Permissions[/b]
Do not upload translations or re-uploads of this mod without my permission.
Unauthorized translations and re-uploads will be reported.

[b]Thank you[/b]
Big thanks to every creator who made this possible:

ConcernedApe for Stardew Valley.
Pathoschild for SMAPI and Content Patcher.
PeacefulEnd for Fashion Sense. These outfits could not exist without it.
spacechase0 for Generic Mod Config Menu.
GH for GH's Peach Tall Body type, the beautiful body these outfits are drawn on.
Bouhm for NPC Map Locations, which helped me test the minimap head icon.

[center]Thank you for downloading, and have fun dressing up!  - JerryBB[/center]
